gloss: with all one's strength; with full force

definitions.gloss: with all one's strength; with full force; as hard as one can
definitions.explanation: Using the maximum amount of physical or mental effort. Describes putting everything one has into an action.

examples.japanese: {力一杯|ちからいっぱい}ボールを{投|な}げた。
examples.english: I threw the ball with all my strength.

examples.japanese: {力一杯|ちからいっぱい}{走|はし}って、ゴールに{飛|と}び{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I ran with all my might and dove across the finish line.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちは{力一杯|ちからいっぱい}{綱|つな}を{引|ひ}いて、{赤組|あかぐみ}が{勝|か}った。
examples.english: The children pulled the rope with all their might, and the red team won.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {力|ちから} (strength) + {一杯|いっぱい} (full). Can also be written {力|ちから}いっぱい. Primarily describes physical effort but can also apply to mental or emotional effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {力一杯|ちからいっぱい}{引|ひ}く (to pull with all one's strength)
- {力一杯|ちからいっぱい}{叩|たた}く (to hit with full force)
- {力一杯|ちからいっぱい}{頑張|がんば}る (to try one's hardest)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {全力|ぜんりょく}で: with full power — slightly more formal
- {精一杯|せいいっぱい}: to the best of one's ability — broader, includes non-physical effort
